When public, anyone can trigger PR deployments. Otherwise only PRs from branches in the same repository are deployed and fork PRs are blocked.<0/><1/><2>Secrets:</2> the code of a fork PR can read all environment variables of its preview. When public, previews do not get preview variables that still have the production value, and shared variables are resolved only in preview variables, not in the compose file of the PR. This is not full isolation: the preview runs on the same server as production, and with the Docker Compose build pack Coolify deploys the compose file of the PR, which can, for example, mount host paths. Give previews their own values, and do not use production secrets in them.
